name: Down at the Docks
label: Quest
description: Down at the Docks: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have heard tales of the mighty ships that sail between Ratchet and Booty Bay! That would be so cool to sail on the ocean and fight in many great sea battles. Maybe I will be a mighty Horde sailor when I grow up! Yeah!
Would you take me to see the Ratchet docks, please? I promise I won't get into the water or cause any trouble - I just want to see the big boats and smell the salty sea water! Yeah!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow, the ocean is HUGE! There were a lot of seagulls and stuff too - It's just as noisy and as bustling as I thought it would be. There are pirates near by too - so cool!
Thank you for taking me to Ratchet, friend. That was so awesome!
